correctness.rationale: For \(a,c\ne0\), the degree-12 polynomial \(F(x^4)\), where \(F(t)=at^3+bt+c\), is squarefree if and only if \(\Delta=-4ab^3-27a^2c^2\ne0\). Its smooth completion has genus 5. The four nonzero fourth powers are \(1,4,13,16\), and rational points arise exactly when one value of \(F(t)\) is a square, or the coefficient at 0 or infinity is square. Normalizing nonsquare \(c\) to 3, an exhaustive 8-by-17 finite table has precisely four smooth pointless pairs: \((3,5),(5,3),(12,14),(14,12)\). Under \(x\mapsto ux\), these form the single orbit of \((5,3)\). The standalone program independently verifies 4096 smooth and 32 pointless triples among 4352, and the orbit. The finite enumeration covers the entire claimed family.

value.rationale: The family has a natural degree-four Galois projection to elliptic curves, so its arithmetic pointless stratum is a motivated covering invariant, not an arbitrary slice. The complete 4352-parameter count and single-class rigidity are structurally meaningful refinements of earlier existence theorems. The exact classification is finite and exhaustive and identifies the unique isomorphism class within this family where all ground-field fibers are inert.
